titel: The Red Flags You Can't Ignore With A Prenup

einzeiler: How prenups reveal core values and red flags in relationships
kurzfassung: Divorce attorney Dennis Vetrano joins the hosts to discuss prenups as a window into a partner's core values and true character. The conversation covers common red flags in prenup negotiations, the immense emotional and financial toll of divorce, and the importance of maintaining independence. The guests and hosts also share personal experiences with high-profile pressure and letting go of the need for external approval.
stichpunkte: Treating a prenup as an extension of relationship transparency rather than just a plan for divorce
Observing how a partner approaches negotiating terms to uncover core values and potential red flags
Recognizing that individuals experiencing divorce can shift significantly from their normal baseline personality
Navigating the heavy emotional and financial trauma of divorce while parenting
Managing the intense pressure of maintaining a public persona and brand
Starting prenup preparations by compiling a thorough net worth statement of assets
Ensuring both partners maintain their own independent identity and sources of income
Reaching a point of self-acceptance where external opinions and judgments no longer matter

clips.hook: Three degrees away from normal during divorce
clips.text: Psychologists note that individuals undergoing a divorce experience a temporary shift that places them significantly far from their standard baseline personality.

clips.hook: Crying in the closet and feeling exploited
clips.text: One host shares the raw vulnerability of dealing with the aftermath of divorce, feeling overwhelmed by private tears and public scrutiny.

clips.hook: A no-cheating clause resistance as a warning sign
clips.text: Pushing back against fidelity clauses in a prenup can indicate that someone is already engaging in infidelity.

clips.hook: Entering relationships at eighteen and parenting solo
clips.text: Reflecting on a lifelong pattern of romantic attachments starting at age 18 while adjusting to the reality of the first day without the kids.

clips.hook: Ordering a cheeseburger at a black-tie event
clips.text: Comfort with personal identity allows someone to show up to formal gatherings entirely unconcerned with social expectations.

beschreibung:
Thinking about getting a prenup in your chapter two marriage? You need to listen to what divorce attorney Dennis Vetrano says to look out for when reviewing a prenup!
